title: F Troop
description:
S02 E15 — Survival of the Fittest
Parmenter and Agarn are slated for an Army survival test, frontier style.

title: Wild West Chronicles
description:
S02 E01 — The Bone War
Bones, not gold, inspires a rush of treasure hunters to flood the windblown bluffs of Wyoming; after stumbling upon a strange fossil, a man gets caught in the crossfire of rival paleontologists warring over a trove of dinosaur bones.

title: Wild West Chronicles
description:
S02 E08 — The Gold Rush Lawman
When failed prospector John Hicks Adams is elected sheriff of Santa Clara County, he must prove that he won't be a bust as a lawman too; just weeks into the job, his courage is tested when a band of stagecoach robbers begins terrorizing the area.

title: Into the Wild Frontier
description:
S01 E04 — Lewis & Clark: Captains of Discovery
As Meriwether Lewis and William Clark trek into the uncharted West, the rivers become too shallow for boats; they must find friendly Native Americans willing to trade for horses or risk spending winter on the wrong side of the Rocky Mountains.

title: The Cowboy Way: Alabama
description:
S05 E04 — Cash Cows
The cowboys head back to Texas to help out with a two-day cattle drive; Misty continues training her mare for Cody's rodeo; Jaclyn and Matthew pick up the slack while Booger is away; Kaley's cowboy houseguest continues to cause friction.

title: Maverick
description:
S02 E12 — Prey of the Cat
The wife of a friend falls in love with Bart while he is recovering at their secluded mountain cabin.

title: Cheyenne
description:

Cheyenne takes the job of marshal and gets caught between a man's jealousy and a town's greed.

title: Cheyenne

description:

After a bank robbery, two Pinkerton detectives join forces to track the notorious Missouri Kid; during a shootout, the Missouri Kid kills seasoned detective Charles Schumacher, leaving young George Dougherty to finish the job and avenge his death.

title: Wild West Chronicles
description:
S03 E08 — The Many Faces of Charles Siringo
Unable to apprehend the train-robbing Smith Brothers, Sheriff Doc Shores calls the Pinkerton National Detective Agency for assistance; the agency sends Charles Siringo, an undercover specialist known for his unorthodox methods of capturing criminals.

description:
